description_zh: 获取操作审计数据投递
name: GetServiceTrail

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the instance. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Center.
ap-southeast-1: Singapore
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的实例所在地域的ID。取值：

cn-hangzhou：中心
ap-southeast-1：新加坡
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member accounts in the resource folder, which is an Alibaba Cloud account.
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

ServiceTrail.description_en: The configuration information of the service trail

Config.description_en:
The enabling status of the service trail. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Shutdown
Config.description_zh:
服务跟踪开启状态。取值为：

on：  开启
off：  关闭

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the service trail was created. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 服务跟踪创建时间戳，单位毫秒

UpdateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the service was last updated. Unit: milliseconds
UpdateTime.description_zh: 服务最近更新时间戳，单位毫秒
